sources: docs/decision-records/DECISIONS-COMMENTS.md (CMT-001 amendment, CMT-003 Matter audiences addendum, CMT-002 Document references addendum, CMT-003/CMT-011 chat parity and attachment previews addendum)

corrections.before: Business Users need access to the record. Business Users reply on their own Request and do not need access to the Contract or Matter created from it.
corrections.after: A Business User must be on the team of a non-archived Contract or Matter. Business Users reply on their Request until conversion; conversion adds the Requester to the new record's team, and current team membership then controls access.
corrections.basis: contractTeamScope/matterTeamScope limit business_user to non-archived records they are on; requestArm.resolve hands a converted Request to the record arm; createContract/createMatter insert a team row for businessOwnerId, which convert.ts sets to the requester (DD-023 section 5).

corrections.where: Choose an audience on a record, step 2, step 4, table, and paragraph
corrections.before: Composer offers Legal only, Working team, and Full thread under Audience.
corrections.after: On a Contract or Matter the composer offers Legal Only and Contract Team or Matter Team, starting on the team audience. Older working_team comments show as Internal team and cannot be chosen. Contract Team and Matter Team are the Full Thread tier.
corrections.basis: composerTiers returns [legal_only, full_thread] for Member+ on matter/contract/request; useComposer defaults matter and contract to full_thread; tierLabel maps full_thread to Contract Team/Matter Team and working_team to Internal team; the Audience legend is screen-reader-only; CMT-003 addenda of 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-10.

corrections.where: Mention a person, step 2 and paragraph
corrections.before: Choose the person from People you can mention.
corrections.after: Choose the person on the People tab. Administrators and Legal Team Members also see a Files tab; a file reference links a Document, grants no access, and sends no notification.
corrections.basis: The typeahead has People and Files tabs (Files only when canReadContracts); the listbox is named People and files you can mention; CMT-002 Document references addendum.

corrections.where: Attach paper to a comment, step 4
corrections.before: Select an attachment's filename to retrieve it.
corrections.after: Select the filename to preview it; use its Download control to retrieve the file.
corrections.basis: CommentAttachmentRows: the filename button opens AttachmentPreview; a separate link named Download {filename} downloads.

corrections.where: Attach paper to a comment, filing paragraph
corrections.before: Only Contract conversations offer File; Matter and Request conversations do not.
corrections.after: Contract and Matter conversations offer File to Contract or File to Matter, also in the preview; Request conversations and archived records do not; the attachment shows Filed to with its Document and Version.
corrections.basis: matter-record.tsx passes filing with canFile for Member+ on a non-frozen Matter; comments.attachments.fileMatter; the filing route accepts contract and matter and refuses other threads; comments.attachments.filedTo.

corrections.where: Reply from the Portal, conversion paragraph
corrections.before: After conversion, the Request address opens its record.
corrections.after: Added that the Requester is on the new record's team and that an archived destination shows the original request with no conversation.
corrections.basis: portal-request.tsx redirects to redirectTo and shows portal.request.archivedRecord for an archived destination; DD-023 section 5.

corrections.where: Read the Activity feed, second paragraph
corrections.before: A Request in the Inbox has its conversation but no History panel.
corrections.after: Added that a converted Request in the Inbox has no conversation and the reader opens its linked record.
corrections.basis: inbox-request.tsx passes no applets and disables the comment applet when status is converted.

confirmedClaims: Comments applet label Comments; composer box New comment; submit Comment; Show older at the head of the thread.
Unread badge excludes the viewer's own comments, deleted and redacted comments, and tiers the viewer cannot read; opening the loaded thread marks it read.
Inbox Request composer offers Legal only and Shared with requester, starts on Legal only; older working_team Request comments read Working team and are not shared with Business Users.
Mentioned list with Remove {name}; Widen the audience? with Widen and post and Cancel; cancel posts nothing; edit keeps the mention list.
Attach files, up to five files (MAX_COMMENT_ATTACHMENTS = 5), Remove {filename} before posting; attachments carry the comment's tier.

Comment actions offers Edit and Delete to the author on a live comment; Edit comment, Save, Cancel, edited marker; Delete this comment? then Delete leaves Comment deleted by its author.; tier immutable.

Redact is Administrator-only, reaches author-deleted comments, and removes body, revisions, mentions, attachment rows and blobs; tombstone Comment removed by an Administrator.; an edit of another author's words is refused.
Portal record shell mounts the same applet with surface portal: no audience picker, Full Thread only, own edit and delete, no Redact, no filing.
Staff History is Member+ only and tier-filtered; Portal History returns Full Thread comment actions and business Field edits only, on Contracts, Matters, and never-converted Requests.
Full Thread on a Contract or Matter reaches Business Users currently on the team; removal removes access through old Request links (DD-023).

corrections.before: Opening the panel marks the displayed items read.
corrections.after: Opening the panel marks nothing read; a dot marks unread items; selecting an item marks that item read; Mark all read appears only while unread items exist.
corrections.basis: NotificationBell calls markRead for the one clicked item and has no read-on-open write; the read route summary cites the NOT-005 2026-09-09 amendment; Mark all read renders when unread > 0.

corrections.before: The Portal bell concerns your own Requests and returns you to the Request after conversion.
corrections.after: The Portal bell covers your own Requests and the Contracts and Matters whose team you are on; a converted Request item opens the record while you stay on its team.
corrections.basis: portalScope admits requester events filtered by requestDestinationScope and shared record events through portalRecordScope; hrefFor sends Portal contract and matter items to /portal/contracts|matters/N.

corrections.where: Staff group table, Assigned to you and New requests rows
corrections.before: Assigned to you omitted Contract team additions and generated Contracts; New requests covered only new Requests.
corrections.after: Assigned to you names Contract team additions and generated Contracts where you are the Legal Owner; New requests names unassigned Contracts arriving in the Inbox.
corrections.basis: EVENT_GROUP maps contract.team_added and contract.generated to assigned_to_you and contract.generated_unassigned to new_requests; GROUP_COPY detail strings.

corrections.before: A Business User does not receive Inbox arrivals or Legal-only Knowledge updates because a switch is present.
corrections.after: A Business User does not receive Inbox arrivals, date reminders, or the daily briefing.
corrections.basis: Business Users never see the staff pane; inboxAudience is Member+; the morning round selects users with role other than business_user.

corrections.where: Change Portal preferences, step 2 and paragraph
corrections.before: Groups named Request updates, Mentions, and Activity on your records; Mentions covers shared comments that name you.
corrections.after: Groups are Request updates, Assigned to you, and Activity on your records; Assigned to you covers Contract team additions and shared mentions on your Contracts and Matters; In-app off stops both channels for that group.
corrections.basis: PORTAL_GROUPS and PORTAL_COPY (portal.settings.assignments = Assigned to you); EVENT_GROUP_POLICY defaults; PORTAL_SHARED_EVENTS.

corrections.before: No statement about Business Users on the team.
corrections.after: Business Users on the team are not offered as recipients, because they receive no date reminders.
corrections.basis: keyDateReminderOptions excludes role business_user; validateKeyDateRecipients refuses them; morning round excludes business_user.

corrections.where: Change Portal preferences, new paragraph after the group paragraph
corrections.before: Activity on your records covers shared comments on your Contracts and Matters. Nothing said that the Requester of a converted Request gets those comments another way.
corrections.after: On a Contract or Matter converted from your Request, a shared comment reaches you as a reply under Request updates (bell item 'replied on your request', email subject 'Legal replied on ...'). Turning off Activity on your records Email does not stop that email; Request updates Email does. Team members who did not raise the Request get the comment under Activity on your records.
corrections.basis: Independent walkthrough found Jonas Weber (Requester of R-123, converted to C-147) got request.replied with email, and Amara Nwosu got comment.posted. Source: commentOnRecord and fanOutToMatter in notifier.ts call requestConvertedInto (audience.ts) for both Contracts and Matters, drop the Requester from comment.posted at full_thread, and raise request.replied, whose group is requester_events (catalog.ts, default In-app and Email on). email.ts subject for request.replied is 'Legal replied on <request>'. Task comments (taskId set) do not raise the reply. Decision: NOT-002 addendum 2026-08-22 (M21/11), 'The reply promise follows the thread onto the record'. The walkthrough classed this as doc-error; the app behaviour is deliberate, so no product bug.

confirmedClaims: Bell trigger named Notifications with unread count; badge caps at 9+; Show older pages 25 at a time; failure texts Notifications could not be read. Close this and open it again. and The older notifications could not be read. Try again.
Staff path profile menu Settings, Personal, Notifications; cards Notification preferences and Briefing; saved status note per card; failed save reverts the switch.

Staff groups and defaults: Assigned to you in-app and email on; Activity on your records in-app on, email off; Dates approaching in-app switch only; New requests in-app on, email off; Knowledge items email switch only.
In-app off suppresses the group entirely, email included (notifier returns no recipients when choice.inApp is false; settings caption).
Briefing sections Approvals, Tasks, Dates, Obligations on and Intake off by default; caption says the switches change email only and Home sections and the bell summary stay on.
Portal header control Notification settings; Portal pane has no Briefing card; defaults Request updates and Assigned to you both on, Activity on your records in-app on and email off.
Morning round runs hourly in UTC, serves a person once per local day after 08:00 in the saved timezone, and uses UTC without a saved timezone.

Key date extra lead times are whole days 0 to 730, at most 20; dialog shows Global reminders and This date will remind; Use the usual audience clears the selection; departed recipients are not reminded and the selection does not widen.
